items.reason: Fixed box-shadow, max-height, -moz-image-region, counter-style (in 5a14d33) and also box-decoration-break (was border-decoration-break); every property/identifier is pinned in a generated `Property Name Tests.swift` per test target (514 entries; names cross-checked against the kebab-case of the type name, the only mismatches were the ones fixed). Left open: PageBreak. `Property` requires one static name per type, but PageBreak is a union of page-break-after/-before/-inside (all of which exist as their own types). Fixing it means removing PageBreak or reworking it, and swift-compositions/swift-css-html-render exposes it via HTML.CSS.pageBreak(_:) and reads PropertyType.property statically: an owner decision. PageBreak is left out of the name test.

items.reason: At-rule descriptors (Keyframes, CounterStyle, FontFace, FontFeatureValues, FontPaletteValues, also ColorProfile) now store an ordered W3C_CSS.Descriptors (insertion order) in 5a14d33d11c34cabd2c8e8e54c7f25ecf84606d9; builder inputs that are Swift dictionaries are applied in sorted key order. Decision: for FontFeatureSettings/FontVariationSettings (dictionary payloads) and the Set-backed keyword types I kept the public payload types and print in a canonical order (sorted tag; enum declaration order via CaseIterable; under/left/right order for TextUnderlinePosition) instead of changing payloads to arrays: the order carries no meaning in CSS for these, and this avoids an API break. Tests pin output with 2+ entries.

items.reason: Defined: none is the identity (none + none = none); a CSS-wide keyword replaces the value (x + .global(k) = .global(k), .global(k) + x = .global(k)). Documented on the operator.

Container stores name + Condition; Condition gains and/or that parenthesize compound operands; && / || keep the lhs name; range prints `min <= width <= max` (SizeComparison gains an internal lowerBound). Media stores its comma list; and distributes over lists, or concatenates, ! on a list of media conditions gives `not ((a) or (b))`. Limitation: Media Queries 4 has no syntax to negate a comma list that contains media types (e.g. `screen, print`); that case keeps the old behaviour (negates the first query) and is documented on Media.not().

items.reason: init(rawValue:) now parses the body (new public W3C_CSS.Block / W3C_CSS.Descriptors in W3C CSS Syntax); FontFeatureValues(_:) quotes (and escapes) the family from the start and unquotes parsed family names.

api_changes: New public types in W3C CSS Syntax: W3C_CSS.Descriptors (+ .Entry) and W3C_CSS.Block (additive).
BorderImageSource, MaskBorderSource, Mask.MaskReference, MaskBorder.Source: the six xGradient(CSSString) cases are replaced by `case gradient(Gradient)` (W3C_CSS_Images.Gradient).
WebkitBoxReflect.ReflectionMask and WebkitMaskBoxImage.Source: linearGradient/radialGradient(CSSString) replaced by `case gradient(Gradient)`; Package.swift: W3C CSS UI now depends on W3C CSS Images.
Mask.linearGradient(_: CSSString) and Mask.radialGradient(_: CSSString) replaced by Mask.gradient(_: Gradient).
TransitionProperty.custom(CSSString) -> custom(Ident) (string literals still compile); TransitionProperty.list prints names escaped as identifiers.
ClipPath.custom(CSSString) -> custom(String) (raw CSS) and ClipPath.init(_: CSSString) -> init(_: String); ClipPath.path still takes CSSString but prints path("...") once.
PositionTryFallbacks.positionArea / FallbackOption.positionArea: CSSString -> PositionArea; customOption: CSSString -> DashedIdent (CSSOM).

Property names changed: BoxShadow.property box-shadow, MaxHeight.property max-height, MozImageRegion.property -moz-image-region, BoxDecorationBreak.property box-decoration-break; CounterStyle.identifier counter-style.

Output changes (no signature change): escaped strings/identifiers, Gradient prelude format, Grid auto-flow side, Offset.percentage, Transform +, Supports/Container/Media composition, Time hashing, CalcSum wrapping, Padding.named, BorderWidth(vertical:horizontal:), fit-content(), path arcs, CounterStyle additive-symbols now comma-separated, FontFace/FontPaletteValues/CounterStyle/ColorProfile/Keyframes/FontFeatureValues keep parsed bodies.
Supports, Container and Media: rawValue now has a didSet that re-parses (stored private condition/rules, name/condition, queries); synthesized Hashable includes those derived fields.
dependents: Searched all of /home/user/cloud-workspace/repos: no package outside swift-w3c-css uses the replaced gradient cases, Mask.linearGradient/radialGradient, TransitionProperty.custom, ClipPath.custom/init, PositionTryFallbacks.positionArea/customOption, PaintOrder.custom, or matches on those enums. swift-compositions/swift-css-html-render/Sources/CSS HTML Rendering/HTML.CSS.swift:3345 exposes PageBreak (unchanged) and :3486 PositionTryFallbacks (type only, unchanged). No dependent test pins the old property names or outputs.
notes: Linux-unbuilt: every changed file was swift-format'ed and passes swiftc -parse; parser helpers (W3C_CSS.Block/Descriptors) were compiled and run standalone. Risky spots for the build: generated `Property Name Tests.swift` (one per test target, module-qualified names, 514 entries), CSS.Context Tests (constructs Geometry arcs via W3C_CSS typealiases and `.pi.full`), tests relying on implicit members of types from modules the test target does not import directly (Gradient in Backgrounds/Masking/UI tests).
